Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, I have visited this Imam
Acknowledging his Imamate
Believing in the obligation of his obedience
And I have come to his shrine with my sins and faults
And the burden of my transgressions
And the multitude of my misdeeds and errors
And what You know about me
Seeking protection in Your pardon
Taking refuge in Your forbearance
Hoping for Your mercy
Taking shelter in Your support
Seeking refuge in Your compassion
Seeking intercession through Your guardian and the son of Your guardians
And Your chosen one and the son of Your chosen ones
And Your trustee and the son of Your trustees
And Your vicegerent and the son of Your vicegerents

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْنَ جَعَلْتَهُمُ الْوَسِيْلَةَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ وَرِضْوَانِكَ
Translation: Those whom You have made the means to Your mercy and pleasure
And the pathway to Your compassion and forgiveness
O Allah, my first need from You

Arabic text: أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِيْ مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِيْ عَلَى كَثْرَتِهَا
Translation: Is that You forgive my past sins despite their abundance

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تَعْصِمَنِيْ فِيمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمْرِي
Translation: And that You protect me in what remains of my life
And purify my religion from what defiles it
And disgraces it and degrades it
And safeguard it from doubt and uncertainty
And corruption and polytheism
And make me steadfast in obedience to You
And obedience to Your Messenger
And his purified and blessed progeny
Your blessings be upon them
And Your mercy and peace and benedictions
And keep me alive as long as You keep me alive in obedience to them
And cause me to die when You cause me to die in obedience to them

Arabic text: وَأَنْ لَا تَمْحُوَ مِنْ قَلْبِيْ مَوَدَّتَهُمْ وَمَحَبَّتَهُمْ
Translation: And do not remove from my heart their love and affection
And the hatred of their enemies
And companionship with their friends and doing good to them

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ أَنْ تَقْبَلَ ذٰلِكَ مِنِّي
Translation: And I ask You, O Lord, to accept this from me
And make Your worship beloved to me
And perseverance in it
And energize me for it
And make Your disobedience and prohibited things hateful to me
And drive me away from them
And prevent me from being negligent in my prayers
And being careless about them
And being lax in them

Arabic text: وَتُوَفِّقَنِيْ لِتَأْدِيَتِهَا كَمَا فَرَضْتَ وَأَمَرْتَ بِهِ
Translation: And grant me success to perform them as You have ordained and commanded
According to the tradition of Your Messenger
Your blessings be upon him and his family
And Your mercy and benedictions
With humility and reverence
And expand my chest for giving zakāt
And giving charity
And doing good deeds
And being kind to the followers of the family of Muhammad
Peace be upon them, and helping them

Arabic text: وَلَا تَتَوَفَّانِيْ إِلَّا بَعْدَ أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِيْ حَجَّ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ
Translation: And do not cause me to die except after granting me the pilgrimage to Your Sacred House
And visiting the grave of Your Prophet
And the graves of the Imams, peace be upon them

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحًا تَرْضَاهَا
Translation: And I ask You, O Lord, for sincere repentance that pleases You
And an intention that You praise
And righteous deeds that You accept

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِيْ وَتَرْحَمَنِيْ إِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي
Translation: And that You forgive me and have mercy on me when You cause me to die
And ease for me the agonies of death

Arabic text: وَتَحْشُرَنِيْ فِيْ زُمْرَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: And resurrect me in the company of Muhammad and his family
Allah's blessings be upon him and them
And admit me to Paradise by Your mercy
And make my tears flow abundantly in Your obedience
And my eyes weeping in what brings me closer to You
And my heart affectionate towards Your friends
And protect me in this world
From defects and calamities
And severe illnesses
And chronic diseases
And all types of afflictions and misfortunes
And turn my heart away from the forbidden
And make Your disobedience hateful to me
And make the lawful beloved to me
And open its doors for me
And make my intention and action firm upon it
And extend my life
And close the doors of tribulation for me

Arabic text: وَلَا تَسْلُبَنِيْ مَا مَنَنْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ
Translation: And do not take away what You have bestowed upon me

Arabic text: وَلَا تَسْتَرِدَّ شَيْئًا مِمَّا أَحْسَنْتَ بِهِ إِلَيَّ
Translation: And do not take back anything that You have granted me

Arabic text: وَلَا تَنْزِعَ مِنِّيْ النِّعَمَ الَّتِيْ أَنْعَمْتَ بِهَا عَلَيَّ
Translation: And do not remove from me the blessings that You have bestowed upon me
And increase what You have given me
And multiply it many times over
And grant me abundant wealth
Ample, pleasant
Wholesome, growing, sufficient
And lasting honor that is sufficient
And extensive, impregnable prestige
And comprehensive, all-encompassing blessings
And make me independent through this from burdensome pursuits
And difficult resources
And deliver me from them in good health
In my religion, myself, and my children
And what You have given me and granted me
And preserve my wealth for me
And all that You have bestowed upon me
And restrain from me the hands of tyrants
And return me to my homeland

Arabic text: وَتُبَلِّغَنِيْ نِهَايَةَ أَمَلِيْ فِيْ دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِي
Translation: And make me attain the fullness of my hope in this world and the hereafter

Arabic text: وَتَجْعَلَ عَاقِبَةَ أَمْرِيْ مَحْمُودَةً حَسَنَةً سَلِيمَةً
Translation: And make the end of my affairs praiseworthy, good, and sound
And make me open-hearted
With abundant means
Of good character
Far from miserliness and withholding
And hypocrisy and lying
And slander and false testimony

Arabic text: وَتُرْسِخَ فِيْ قَلْبِيْ مَحَبَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَشِيعَتِهِمْ
Translation: And implant in my heart the love of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad and their followers

Arabic text: وَتَحْرُسَنِيْ يَا رَبِّ فِيْ نَفْسِيْ وَأَهْلِي
Translation: And guard me, O Lord, in myself and my family
And my wealth and my children
And those in my trust and my brothers
And those who love me and my offspring
By Your mercy and generosity
O Allah, these are my needs before You
And I have considered them numerous due to my baseness and greed
But they are with You small and insignificant
And for You easy and simple

Arabic text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجَاهِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: So I ask You by the status of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
Peace be upon him and them, with You
And by their right upon You
And by what You have obligated for them
And by all Your prophets and messengers
And Your chosen ones and Your guardians
The sincere ones among Your servants
And by Your Greatest, Most Great Name
That You fulfill all of these
And grant them to me
And do not disappoint my hope and expectation

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَشَفِّعْ صَاحِبَ هٰذَا الْقَبْرِ فِيَّ
Translation: O Allah, let the owner of this grave intercede for me

Arabic text: يَا سَيِّدِيْ يَا وَلِيَّ اللَّهِ يَا أَمِيْنَ اللَّهِ
Translation: O my master, O guardian of Allah, O trustee of Allah

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَشْفَعَ لِيْ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ
Translation: I ask you to intercede for me with Allah, the Mighty and Majestic
Regarding all these needs
By the right of your purified forefathers
And by the right of your chosen children

Arabic text: فَإِنَّ لَكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُهُ
Translation: For indeed you have with Allah, whose names are sanctified
An honorable position
And an exalted rank
And extensive influence

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَوْ عَرَفْتُ مَنْ هُوَ أَوْجَهُ عِنْدَكَ
Translation: O Allah, if I knew anyone who has more favor with You
Than this Imam
And his pure forefathers and descendants
Peace and blessings be upon them
I would have made them my intercessors
And placed them before my need and these requests
So hear me
And answer me
And do with me what befits You
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Allah, and whatever my request falls short of
And my strength is unable to reach
And my intelligence does not attain

Arabic text: مِنْ صَالِحِ دِينِيْ وَدُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِي
Translation: Concerning the welfare of my religion, my world, and my hereafter
Bestow it upon me
And preserve me and guard me
And grant me and forgive me
And whoever intends for me evil or harm
From a rebellious devil
Or obstinate ruler
Or opponent in religion
Or rival in worldly matters
Or one who envies me for a blessing
Or oppressor or transgressor
Restrain his hand from me
And turn away his plot from me
And preoccupy him with himself
And protect me from his evil
And the evil of his followers and his devils

Arabic text: وَأَجِرْنِيْ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا يَضُرُّنِيْ وَيُجْحِفُ بِي
Translation: And save me from all that harms me and oppresses me
And grant me all goodness
From what I know and what I do not know

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And forgive me and my parents
And my brothers and sisters
And my paternal uncles and aunts
And my maternal uncles and aunts
And my grandfathers and grandmothers
And their children and descendants
And my spouses and my offspring
And my relatives and my friends
And my neighbors and my brothers in You
From the people of the East and the West
And for all those who love me
From the believing men and women
The living among them and the dead
And for all who have taught me good
Or learned knowledge from me
O Allah, include them in the benefits of my supplication
And my visitation to the shrine of Your proof and Your guardian
And include me in the benefits of their supplications
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful
And convey to Your guardian from them peace
And peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah and His blessings
O my master, O my lord
May Allah bless you
And your soul and your body
You are my means to Allah
And my pathway to Him
And I have the right of loyalty to you and hope in you

Arabic text: فَكُنْ شَفِيعِيْ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ
Translation: So be my intercessor with Allah, the Mighty and Majestic
In addressing this petition of mine
And turning me away from this position of mine with success
In all that I have asked for, by His mercy and power
O Allah, grant me a perfect intellect
And a sound mind
And lasting honor
And a pure heart
And abundant good deeds
And excellent manners
And make all of that for me
And not against me
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful
